permission: Allow Nappa to use Face ID to unlock the app.
chooseBody: Skip the email code next time. Unlock data never leaves this phone.
chooseBackup: You’ll also set a PIN, so you’re never locked out if {{method}} doesn’t work.
createBackup: You’ll use it whenever {{method}} isn’t available.
createBody: You’ll use it to unlock Nappa on this phone.
whyPinBody: Your PIN unlocks Nappa on this phone and never leaves it. You can use an email code if you forget it.
confirmBody: Just to make sure it’s the one you meant.
mismatch: Those PINs didn’t match. Try again.
enterBody: Use your 4-digit PIN to unlock Nappa.
wrong_one: That’s not it. {{count}} try left before a short pause.
wrong_other: That’s not it. {{count}} tries left before a short pause.
pauseBody: Too many tries. You can try your PIN again soon.
pauseMessage: Try again in {{time}}, or use your email to get in now.
bioOffBody: Nappa can’t use {{method}} right now. Turn it back on in Settings, or keep using your PIN.
bioOffBodyUnknown: Nappa can’t use biometrics right now. Turn them back on in Settings, or keep using your PIN.
storageFailure: Quick unlock is unavailable. Try again or use email to get in.
saveFailure: Your PIN couldn’t be saved. Please try again.

faceId.name: Face ID
faceId.title: Turn on Face ID
faceId.body: Nappa opens with a glance. Your PIN still works as a backup.

touchId.title: Turn on Touch ID
touchId.body: Touch the sensor to open Nappa. Your PIN still works as a backup.

fingerprint.title: Unlock with your fingerprint
fingerprint.body: Touch the sensor to open Nappa. Your PIN still works as a backup.

face.name: Face unlock
face.title: Turn on face unlock
face.body: Use your face to open Nappa. Your PIN still works as a backup.

reconnectAfterUnlock: After unlocking, reconnect biometrics in Security & Privacy.
biometricUnavailable: Biometrics are unavailable. You can still use your PIN.
biometricFallback: Use your PIN, or try biometrics again.
biometricSetupFailure: Biometric setup didn’t finish. Try again or keep your PIN only.
pinUnavailable: We couldn’t check your PIN. Try again or use an email code.
chooseMethodBody: Choose how you’d like to unlock Nappa.
switchBody: Nappa will sign this account out and forget its PIN and biometric unlock on this phone. Your logs stay in your account.
